chapters.label: Wembley, 2026
chapters.text: Wembley, the 2026 League Cup final. Arsenal against Manchester City. Nico O'Reilly has just scored a header. Four minutes later, Matheus Nunes crosses from the right... O'Reilly arrives at the far post. Another header! Goal!

chapters.label: Arrive late
chapters.text: Watch again. He starts outside the box, then runs in late, behind the defenders, to the far post.

chapters.label: The header
chapters.text: From beside the goal: forehead, eyes open, and power it down! Two headers in four minutes.

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: Full-backs can score too! Arrive late in the box, and attack the ball with your forehead.
